summary: Checked the working tree against the real cause of the red V26: the bridge returned float progress values and the backend's canonical JSON refuses floats, so the plans query failed and the list had no link. The fix (integer percent 0-100 in the bridge adapter, matching rendering in ResourceListView/ResourceDetailView, tests and docs) is already in the tree and consistent; the backend.ts fix of the previous round (planner and AICORE_ROOT in the E2E environment) is also needed and stays. Only change in this round: the bridge README says progress is an integer percent. Bridge tests (51, incl. a no-floats assertion on every answer), tsc and public-hygiene pass; vitest, eslint and the E2E could not run in this sandbox.
